question: How can liberation be claimed if no experience anywhere is devoid of auspicious or inauspicious karma?
premises: auspicious and inauspicious experiences are everywhere
no experience is ever completely devoid of them
liberation requires freedom from such binding experience
inference: The verse denies that any experience is free from auspicious or inauspicious content, so liberation cannot rest on mere absence of experience.
uncertainties: whether tena refers to the experiencer or the experience
plain_english: Auspicious and inauspicious things are to be experienced, and nowhere is anything devoid of them.
